content.value: A hollow sphere of inside radius $r = a$ and outside radius $r = b$ is electrically heated at the inner surface at a constant rate of $q _ { 0 } \mathrm { ~ W / m } ^ { 2 }$ . At the outer surface it dissipates heat by convection into a fluid at temperature $T _ { \alpha }$ with a heat transfer coefficient h. The thermal conductivity k of the solid is constant. Develop expressions for the determination of the inner and outer surface temperatures $T _ { 1 }$ and $T _ { 2 }$ of the sphere. Calculate the inner and outer surface temperatures for $a = 3 \ { \mathrm { c m } } , \ b = 5 \ { \mathrm { c m } } , \ h = 4 0 0 \ { \mathrm { W / m ^ { 2 } . ^ { \circ } C } } , T _ { \alpha } = 1 0 0 ^ { \circ } { \mathrm { C } } , k = 1 5 \ { \mathrm { W / m . ^ { \circ } C } } ,$ and $q _ { 0 } { = } 1 0 ^ { 5 } \mathrm { W } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$
